Safety-Control Integrator said about it: I read the Elevator landing doors and user safety (E68) which states if the landing door opens it cuts off the safety circuit and stops the whole elevator, and I read the CN207312901U - Prevent the protective device of accidental movement of elevator cage - Google Patents (E69) which shows a door interlock switch whose Normally Closed (NC), meaning wired shut until opened, contact opens to prevent movement, which maps to my series NC loop where any open latches trip without power and stays stopped, because both must fail safe and stay safe.
